purpose: Allow only the reviewed pre-storage-migration Qwen JPEG-EOT records to resume under the operationally hardened runner.

approvals.review: The intervening commits changed submission, storage, documentation, provenance validation, and added an isolated self-collected dataset scope. The collected-only prompt restoration does not run for public sources. The public attack algorithm, model, frozen inputs, and defense evaluation remained scientifically compatible.
